mapper.select: SELECT sr.*, d.name as doctor_name, d.title as doctor_title, d.specialty as doctor_specialty, dept.name as department_name, c.name as clinic_name FROM schedule_rule sr LEFT JOIN doctor d ON sr.doctor_id = d.id LEFT JOIN department dept ON sr.department_id = dept.id LEFT JOIN clinic c ON sr.clinic_id = c.id ORDER BY sr.priority DESC, sr.created_at DESC

SELECT sr.*, d.name as doctor_name, d.title as doctor_title, d.specialty as doctor_specialty, dept.name as department_name, c.name as clinic_name FROM schedule_rule sr LEFT JOIN doctor d ON sr.doctor_id = d.id LEFT JOIN department dept ON sr.department_id = dept.id LEFT JOIN clinic c ON sr.clinic_id = c.id WHERE sr.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND ( (sr.start_date IS NULL OR sr.start_date <= #{endDate}) AND (sr.end_date IS NULL OR sr.end_date >= #{startDate}) ) ORDER BY sr.priority DESC, sr.created_at DESC

mapper.select: SELECT sr.id, sr.rule_name as ruleName, sr.rule_type as ruleType, sr.doctor_id as doctorId, sr.department_id as departmentId, sr.clinic_id as clinicId, sr.week_days as weekDays, sr.time_slots as timeSlots, sr.start_date as startDate, sr.end_date as endDate, sr.slot_type as slotType, sr.total_slots as totalSlots, sr.max_daily_schedules as maxDailySchedules, sr.max_continuous_days as maxContinuousDays, sr.skip_weekends as skipWeekends, sr.skip_holidays as skipHolidays, sr.status, sr.priority, sr.description, sr.created_by as createdBy, sr.created_at as createdAt, sr.updated_at as updatedAt, d.name as doctorName, d.title as doctorTitle, dept.name as departmentName, c.name as clinicName, CASE sr.rule_type WHEN 'FIXED' THEN '固定排班' WHEN 'ROTATING' THEN '轮班' WHEN 'FLEXIBLE' THEN '弹性排班' WHEN 'ON_CALL' THEN '值班' ELSE sr.rule_type END as ruleTypeName, CASE sr.slot_type WHEN 'EXPERT' THEN '专家号' WHEN 'SPECIALIST' THEN '专科号' WHEN 'ORDINARY' THEN '普通号' WHEN 'EMERGENCY' THEN '急诊号' ELSE sr.slot_type END as slotTypeName, CASE sr.status WHEN 'ACTIVE' THEN '启用' WHEN 'INACTIVE' THEN '禁用' WHEN 'EXPIRED' THEN '已过期' WHEN 'DRAFT' THEN '草稿' ELSE sr.status END as statusName FROM schedule_rule sr LEFT JOIN doctor d ON sr.doctor_id = d.id LEFT JOIN department dept ON sr.department_id = dept.id LEFT JOIN clinic c ON sr.clinic_id = c.id WHERE sr.id = #{id}
